query:
SELECT coalesce(c.name, '') AS "category!: String", coalesce(s.name, '') AS "subcategory!: String"
                   FROM inventory i
                   LEFT JOIN subcategory s ON s.id = i.subcategory_id
                   LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = i.category_id
                   WHERE i.sku = ?1 AND i.active = 1
